title: Normalized tower and trace comparison coordinates
statement: Fix the finite-field and coefficient setting $P$ of [def-pur-conventions], with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, and finite coefficient subfields of a fixed $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and fix $j:X\hookrightarrow Z$, $p:Z\to Y$ with $j$ open, $p$ proper, and $f=p\circ j$ a $k$-morphism smooth of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Use the actual complete finite-Tor integral categories, completed pullback and tensor, and the specified compact-support/exceptional adjunctions of [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude, def-pur-integral-derived-operations, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. For a specified coefficient system $S$, a family of field-shriek models $M$, a finite coefficient field $E$ and an integral tower model $m$, define $\mathrm{Stage}(S,M,E,m)$ to consist of: finite-Tor preservation of realized compact support and exceptional image, a completed unit-pullback core, the finite Hom-normalized exceptional comparison, finite-Tor membership of the shifted Tate line $T_E$, the multiplication-normalized ordinary coefficient extension comparison from $\mathbf Q_\ell$, the ringed tensor and open models, K-flat line and unit representatives, and the normalized unit and tensor-source isomorphisms. Include finite-Tor membership of the tensor source and invertibility of its completion and projection maps. All notions are those of [def-pur-realized-tower-purity-data, det-sp-field-extension-towers, def-pur-unit-trace-construction]. Define $\gamma^T$ as the normalized source comparison followed by realized tower purity and the counit-preserving comparison to $S.G$. Its unit value, preceded by the inverse pulled-unit identification, is $a^T_E:T_E\to G_E1$. Define $\tau_E(a)=\epsilon_E P_E(a)$ with the specified left realization, and $C_E(t_0)$ by ordinary coefficient extension and inverse support/twist comparisons. Define $\gamma^{tr}(t,K)$ as the specified adjoint transpose of inverse projection followed by $t\otimes1$, preceded by the normalized tensor-source comparison. PrescribedUnitReductions means that the scalar reduction of the pulled-unit-normalized orientation equals the fixed finite purity map after the finite exceptional comparison at every level. Define the rational input by scalar localization, the rational tower map by localization of $\gamma^T$, and its component by preceding it with rationalSourceComparison and the localized inverse tensor-source comparison, then following it with the exceptional rationalization comparison and representative_eq [thm-pur-rational-and-qbar-purity, def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Define commonImage by modelScalar followed by commonInclusion [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category]. Comparison is the conjunction of the prescribed-unit and invertibility conditions, uniqueness of a permitted base orientation, scalar extension of its counit trace, equality of its trace purity with $\gamma^T$, equality with rationalIso, and the image of its canonical scalar square. These are the existing definitions moved verbatim to a public data module; no new choice or equality is imposed.
